---
title: "Stability Simulations"
output: html_document
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Dynamic stability of each food web: maximum real eigenvalue of randomly
parameterized community matrices. For each food web, the self-damping value at
which 5% of the matrices are stable (QSS = 0.05) is interpolated from a grid of
self-damping values, and then 10,000 matrices are simulated at that value.

Reads `Data/network_info.rds`; adds `selfDamping` to it and writes
`Data/stability_results.rds` (grid) and `Data/stability_results_meig.rds`
(replicates used in the analysis).

## Setup

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

required_packages <- c("purrr", "igraph", "ggplot2", "tibble", "future", "future.apply", "devtools", "tidyverse")
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
  require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Install multiweb from GitHub if not installed
if (!requireNamespace("multiweb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::install_github("lsaravia/multiweb")
}
library(multiweb)

source("R/network_fun.r")

network_info <- readRDS("Data/network_info.rds")
```

## QSS over a grid of self-damping values

The grid is wider for the larger, more connected food webs, which need
stronger self-damping to reach stable matrices. Values at which no matrix is
stable (QSS = 0) are not returned.

```{r simulStability, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# eval = FALSE: long simulation, run by hand.
selfDamping_grid <- list(
  "GulfSanJorge"       = seq(-1, -30, by = -1),
  "BurdwoodBank"       = seq(-1, -30, by = -1),
  "Std BeagleChannel"  = seq(-1, -30, by = -1),
  "PotterCove"         = seq(-1, -30, by = -1),
  "Std Weddell Sea"    = seq(-30, -50, by = -1),
  "Std NorthernScotia" = seq(-40, -60, by = -1),
  "Std SouthernScotia" = seq(-40, -60, by = -1)
)
stopifnot(setequal(names(selfDamping_grid), network_info$site))

plan(multisession, workers = future::availableCores())

stability_results <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(network_info)), function(i) {
  calculate_network_stability_parallel(network_info$igraph[i], network_info$site[i],
                                       nsim = 10000,
                                       selfDamping_range = selfDamping_grid[[network_info$site[i]]])
})

plan(sequential)

saveRDS(stability_results, "Data/stability_results.rds")
```

```{r PlotStabilityResults, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
stability_results <- readRDS("Data/stability_results.rds")

ggplot(stability_results, aes(x = selfDamping, y = QSS)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = site), color = "gray70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = QSS), size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", end = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "reverse") +
  labs(title = "QSS vs Self-Damping by Site", x = "Self-Damping", y = "QSS") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Interpolate self-damping at QSS = 0.05

```{r InterpolateSelfDamping, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# eval = FALSE: overwrites Data/network_info.rds; run by hand.
interpolate_selfDamping <- function(df_site, target_qss = 0.05) {
  df_site <- df_site %>% arrange(selfDamping)

  # Rows where QSS crosses the threshold; use the first crossing
  i <- which(diff(df_site$QSS > target_qss) != 0)
  if (length(i) == 0) return(tibble(site = df_site$site[1], selfDamping = NA_real_))
  i <- i[1]

  x0 <- df_site$QSS[i]
  x1 <- df_site$QSS[i + 1]
  y0 <- df_site$selfDamping[i]
  y1 <- df_site$selfDamping[i + 1]

  slope <- (y1 - y0) / (x1 - x0)
  tibble(site = df_site$site[1], selfDamping = y0 + slope * (target_qss - x0))
}

selfDamping_at_qss05 <- stability_results %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_dfr(~ interpolate_selfDamping(.x, target_qss = 0.05))

stopifnot(!anyNA(selfDamping_at_qss05$selfDamping))

network_info <- network_info %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("selfDamping", "MEing_stable"))) %>%
  inner_join(selfDamping_at_qss05, by = "site")

saveRDS(network_info, "Data/network_info.rds")
```

## Maximum eigenvalues at the interpolated self-damping

```{r calcEigenSelfDamping, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# eval = FALSE: long simulation, run by hand.
network_info <- readRDS("Data/network_info.rds")

plan(multisession, workers = future::availableCores())

stability_results_meig <- simulate_qss_fixed_selfDamping(
  networks = network_info$igraph,
  sites = network_info$site,
  selfDamping_values = network_info$selfDamping,
  nsim = 10000
)

plan(sequential)

saveRDS(stability_results_meig, "Data/stability_results_meig.rds")
```
